notes: Licensed, not public domain. /api/mcp/v1 requires Authorization: Bearer with a glm_ key (100 req/s, cursor pagination). Two obligations attach to any view that shows this data: a visible credit naming Glama, linked to https://glama.ai with no rel=nofollow/sponsored/ugc; and, for every record presented, a link to THAT record's listing URL as the API returned it.
